areas.label: AI and machine-learning product work
areas.description: Specifies, builds, evaluates or launches features powered by machine-learning models or large language models.
examples: Defined the evaluation set and pass criteria for a support chatbot
Chose between two models based on cost, latency and accuracy
Wrote prompt and guardrail requirements for an AI agent

areas.label: Business cases and economics
areas.description: Builds business cases, pricing or cost models, or is accountable for a budget, revenue or unit economics.
examples: Built the business case that funded a new pricing tier
Modelled and reduced cost per transaction
Owned an annual budget for a product area

areas.label: Customer and account management
areas.description: Manages customer accounts, escalations and renewals or resolves customer issues.
examples: Managed renewals and escalations for enterprise accounts
Resolved recurring customer issues with the support team

areas.label: Data analysis
areas.description: Analyses data, funnels, experiments or metrics; builds dashboards or models.
examples: Built a funnel dashboard for onboarding
Analysed an A/B test and recommended a variant

areas.label: Data quality and governance
areas.description: Defines, certifies or controls data: shared definitions, quality checks, lineage, access and consent controls.
examples: Defined the single "active customer" definition used across reports
Set up data-quality checks and an access-request process
Owned consent flags in a customer data pipeline

areas.label: Delivery and execution
areas.description: Plans and coordinates delivery, launches and dependencies.
examples: Planned and coordinated a release with engineering and QA
Managed launch dependencies and dates

areas.label: Design and user research
areas.description: Interaction design, usability testing and design research.
examples: Ran usability tests on a new checkout flow
Designed wireframes for the settings page

areas.label: Communicating with senior leadership
areas.description: Presents strategy, progress, risks or decisions to senior leaders, or writes decision papers for them.
examples: Presented the quarterly roadmap to the CTO and CFO
Wrote the decision memo for the leadership committee
Ran the monthly business review with directors

areas.label: Go-to-market and growth
areas.description: Marketing, acquisition, campaigns and go-to-market.
examples: Planned the launch campaign with marketing
Ran acquisition experiments for a new segment

areas.label: Operations and process
areas.description: Runs operations and improves processes.
examples: Redesigned the refund process to cut handling time
Ran day-to-day operations for a service desk

areas.label: Outcome ownership
areas.description: Accountable for product outcomes such as adoption, conversion, retention or revenue.
examples: Accountable for the activation rate of a product area
Owned a revenue or retention target

areas.label: People leadership
areas.description: Leads or mentors people or teams.
examples: Managed a team of five analysts
Mentored two junior colleagues

areas.label: Prioritisation and backlog
areas.description: Owns backlog, release or feature prioritisation.
examples: Prioritised the integrations backlog each sprint
Decided what went into each release

areas.label: Product and customer discovery
areas.description: Problem, customer or user discovery that shapes what is built.
examples: Interviewed customers to validate a redesign
Ran problem discovery before committing to a feature

areas.label: Quality and testing
areas.description: Tests software and manages defects.
examples: Wrote and ran regression tests
Triaged and tracked defects

areas.label: Requirements analysis
areas.description: Elicits requirements, process maps or specifications.
examples: Gathered requirements from merchants
Wrote specifications and process maps

areas.label: Roadmap ownership
areas.description: Owns or sets a roadmap or product strategy for a product area.
examples: Set the six-month roadmap for a product area
Owned the product strategy for a feature set

areas.label: Stakeholder management
areas.description: Coordinates stakeholders and cross-functional partners.
examples: Aligned operations, finance and engineering on a change
Ran weekly stakeholder reviews

areas.label: Strategy and portfolio
areas.description: Sets multi-product, portfolio or organisation-level strategy.
examples: Set strategy across three related products
Decided investment across a portfolio of initiatives

areas.label: Technical engineering
areas.description: Designs, builds or integrates software, APIs or models.
examples: Built and maintained payment APIs
Designed a data pipeline

capabilities.title: Understand users and customers and set priorities from their needs
capabilities.description: Learn about users and customers through research, feedback and data, and use that to decide what matters.

capabilities.title: Product vision, strategy and roadmap
capabilities.description: Set direction for a product and turn it into a sequenced roadmap.

capabilities.title: Turn problems into requirements and priorities
capabilities.description: Write specifications, PRDs or data contracts, own a backlog and decide what comes first.

capabilities.title: Define outcome metrics and make data-informed decisions
capabilities.description: Decide how success is measured and use data to choose and adjust.

capabilities.title: Cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder communication
capabilities.description: Work with engineering, design, business and leadership, including without direct authority.

capabilities.title: Iterative delivery across the product lifecycle
capabilities.description: Ship, measure and iterate, from launch to retirement.

capabilities.title: Scope: several products or a complex, high-risk product
capabilities.description: Own a group of products, or one complex or high-risk product.

capabilities.title: Coaching, mentoring and product leadership
capabilities.description: Develop other product people and lead without a title.

capabilities.title: Executive-level communication
capabilities.description: Present direction, risks and results to senior leaders.

capabilities.title: Planning across teams and functions
capabilities.description: Plan work that spans several teams and manage the dependencies.
